entities.summary: Alexander Aleksandrovich Dragunov was a Russian / Soviet philologist and Sinologist from the Institute of Oriental Manuscripts in Leningrad. He was considered a leading expert on the Dungan language and was involved in creating Latinxua Sin Wenz. He was the teacher of Sergey Yakhontov.
